text.en:
Casting [Air Move] causes you to rapidly descend to the ground, instantly <stasis/>Shattering any <stasis/>Frozen targets or <stasis/>Stasis Crystals in a 8.5 meter radius.

Shatterdive deals a small amount of damage on impact, then deals an additional higher damage instance against <stasis/>Frozen enemies.

<stasis/>Shattering a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal or <stasis/>Frozen Target with Shatterdive grants x5 Stacks of <stasis/>Frost Armor in PvE (x7 with <stasis/>Whisper of Rime), and x2 stacks in PvP.

Grants Fall Damage Immunity and ?% Damage Resistance against <stasis/>Crystal Shatter Damage while diving.
